static_traits.name: 王雅宁
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with friends；在学校与同伴聚会中社交受影响
static_traits.medical_history: without显著身体疾病；过去not yet出现类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 略显紧张但开放、配合度高，表达清晰，能进行自我Reflection，态度积极

basic_info.main_problem: 我感到朋友认为我因为把所有钱都花在漫画上而很怪，因而产生not安全感和Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: When I realized these thoughts and feelings were affecting my self-esteem and self-confidence, I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: 曾因喜欢超级英雄而被同学取笑；这使我对自己的兴趣产生羞耻与not安，逐渐not愿在同伴面前分享，担心被评判与嘲笑。

core_beliefs: 我是怪异的、not会被同伴接纳
我的兴趣not符合年龄，会让人觉得我幼稚

special_situations.event: 几个月前在学校without意间听到朋友讨论我的漫画收藏
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我把所有钱都花在漫画上，do not人就会认为我怪或幼稚
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免谈论漫画和超级英雄，以掩饰not安全感

special_situations.event: 在学校或同伴Social gatherings时出现关于兴趣或消费的聊天话题
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I talk about my love of comics, I will be judged or mocked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding related topics, restraining expression of interests in front of peers

special_situations.event: Recalling the experience of being teased by classmates for liking superheroes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次被取笑意味着我的兴趣在do not人眼里都not被认可
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces sharing interests in front of peers to avoid being teased again

special_situations.event: When noticing that one has spent almost all one's money on comics
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我把所有钱都花在漫画上，就说明我not成熟、not负责任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplaying or hiding one's spending and interests in front of others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我这样很not成熟，朋友会因此远离我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and accepted by peers, able to comfortably express and share my interests
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被嘲笑、被评判与被排斥
defense_goal: 通过隐藏兴趣与回避谈论来维持关系的安全感，减少羞耻与not安

object_relations.self_representation: not被接纳、容易被嘲笑的局外人
object_relations.object_representation: 爱评判与可能嘲笑自己的同伴

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling revolves around 'how friends view her comic hobby' and invites her to provide concrete evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向把内在的not安与羞耻感投向他人，假定他人正在评判自己（移情：将他人视作可能的评判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 保持Empathy与支持的语气，温和地邀请其区分事实与推测；use具体化追问（何时、何地、谁在场）与证据检验，鼓励表达当下情绪体验。

manifestations: 因担心被评判而回避分享兴趣；Tense relationships with friends、not敢做真实的自己；对父母虽关系亲近但犹豫表达not安全感

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 会谈开始时表示紧张与not安
在同伴面前谨慎克制地表达兴趣
出现Self-doubt与自责（担心自己“很怪”或“not成熟”）

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 认为朋友在评判或看not起自己，尽管缺乏直接证据（主要依据一次without意听到的谈话）

positive_force: 与父母关系亲近，具备潜在支持资源
学业not yet受影响，基本功能维持Good
Proactively seeks counseling with a positive attitude, willing to try homework and cognitive restructuring
能清晰表达并进行自我Reflection
Love of comics brings stable intrinsic interest and a sense of meaning
negative_force: 读心术与过度概括等认知偏差ReinforcementSelf-doubt
害怕被评判导致回避表达与社交克制
Tense relationships with friends，互动质量下降
对父母表达犹豫，支持系统利用not足

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids talking about comics and related topics at school and in social settings
antecedent: 在学校或同伴聚会谈到兴趣或消费
Thinks about friends discussing own comic collection a few months ago
接触到与漫画相关的聊天或线索
target_behavior.core_reason: Was teased by classmates, forming the belief 'others will judge me', accompanied by cognitive biases of mind reading and overgeneralization
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的负面评价与嘲笑，降低羞耻与Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with friends、难以做真实的自己，社交乐趣下降

target_behavior.behavior: 在社交情境中显著的not安全感与Self-doubt
antecedent: 注意到自己把钱几乎都花在漫画上并担心not被认可
target_behavior.core_reason: 将兴趣与“幼稚/not符合年龄”等标签关联，担心被negate与排斥
target_behavior.function: 通过Self-denial与自我克制来尝试预防外界negate与冲突
target_behavior.consequence: 自尊与自信受影响，但学业not yet受影响；社交互动受阻、活动享受度下降
